binding_rationale: Chosen because collaborator access is live and the repo shows active issue usage aligned with SocioProphet governance and planning work.

observed_issue_style.title_pattern: Descriptive work-item titles, sometimes with EPIC or P0 or E0 prefixes.

github_issue_body_template:
Goal: {goal_summary}

Definition of Done:
- [ ] Closure criteria satisfied
- [ ] Evidence attached
- [ ] Review completed

Acceptance Criteria:
- [ ] Severity and SLA fields populated
- [ ] Reason codes preserved
- [ ] Dependencies enumerated

Exit criteria:
- closure_rule_code: {closure_rule_code}
- escalation_rule_code: {escalation_rule_code}
